vellum.$description: Vellum — Page canvas, hairline dividers, link underlines, card-edge borders — the warm-gray field that holds all content

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, nav links, body copy — the default reading color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, list items, supporting copy — one step lighter than primary ink

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Headings and editorial emphasis — slightly warm dark for serif display

stone.$description: Stone — Tertiary text, icon fills, meta labels

pebble.$description: Pebble — Muted body text, image captions, fine print

ash.$description: Ash — Rarely-used border, subtle structural separator

slate.$description: Slate — Subdued heading variant, de-emphasized titles

pressed-ink.$description: Pressed Ink — Primary action button fill — the only dark surface on the canvas, creating the only moment of visual weight

midnight.$description: Midnight — Secondary dark surface, alternate button fill

degular.$description: UI and body sans — navigation, buttons, body copy, metadata, links, tags, resumé dates. Carries all functional text. Weights step from 400 body to 700 for emphasis in headings and dates.

blanco.$description: Editorial serif — hero headline, resumé role titles, section headings, and any text that should read as 'published' rather than 'navigational'. Single weight 400, letting size and the serif's own authority carry hierarchy.
